# @ndigo/auth-client

Client-side authentication for Ndigo — AuthClient, ClientAuthGuard, and OIDC adapter

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `AuthClient` — Client-side authentication manager.
- `AuthRouteMetadata` *(type)* — Metadata for a route's authentication requirements.
- `extractAuthMetadata` — Extracts authentication metadata from a route's handler.
- `ClientAuthGuard` — A client-side guard for the Ndigo router that enforces authentication and authorization requirements declared via the `@authenticated` and `@authorized` decora…
- `AuthHeaderInterceptor` — HTTP interceptor that injects an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header into outgoing requests when a valid session is available.
- `OIDCErrorCode` *(type)* — Error codes for OIDC failures. The message is safe to expose; the cause (when attached) carries internal detail.
- `OIDCError` — An OIDC-specific failure. Every authorization/token failure mode throws this so callers can distinguish provider errors from programming errors.
- `OIDCAdapterConfig` *(type)* — Configuration for the OIDC adapter.
- `AuthorizationRequest` *(type)* — A pending authorization-code request created by `OIDCAdapter.createAuthorizationRequest`.
- `DiscoveryDocument` *(type)* — Validated subset of an OIDC discovery document.
- `TokenResponse` *(type)* — Validated token-endpoint response.
- `PendingAuthorization` *(type)* — One pending authorization-code request: the values `OIDCAdapter.createAuthorizationRequest` generates and `OIDCAdapter.exchangeCodeForTokens` needs to redeem t…
- `PendingAuthorizationStore` *(type)* — Persistence seam for pending authorization requests.
- `RefreshTokenBinding` *(type)* — The subject binding recorded for a refresh token: which principal the token was issued for. Set when the code exchange (or a rotation) captures the token; cons…
- `RefreshTokenStore` *(type)* — Persistence seam for refresh-token bindings.
- `OIDCResult` *(type)* — The result of a token-endpoint exchange: the `AuthResult` contract plus the provider's refresh token. `refreshToken` is `null` when the provider issued none fo…
- `AuthAdapter` *(type)*
- `Principal` *(type)*
- `AuthResult` *(type)*
- `InMemoryPendingAuthorizationStore` — Default PendingAuthorizationStore: a bounded in-memory map scoped to a single adapter instance.
- `InMemoryRefreshTokenStore` — Default RefreshTokenStore: a bounded in-memory map scoped to a single adapter instance.
- `OIDCAdapter` — An AuthAdapter implementation for OpenID Connect (OIDC).
